// diagnostic

E0613

Property-test (`#Test fn`) parameter has a type the runner can't generate

What

Property-test (`#Test fn`) parameter has a type the runner can't generate

Why

The property-test runner fills each parameter with generated values, so it needs a type it knows how to generate

Fix

Use only a property-test parameter type the runner can generate.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0613: tests/ui/E0613_property_test_parameter_needs_a_generator.stderr.

Error [jet.UngeneratablePropertyParameter]: A property test can't generate values of type `Point`
  --> tests/ui/E0613_property_test_parameter_needs_a_generator.jet:8:26
    |
  8 | #Test uses_point: fn(pt: Point) {
    |                          ^^^^^
 Why: A parameterized `#Test fn` is a property test: Jet generates inputs from each parameter's type, but this type has no built-in generator
 Fix: Use a generatable type (Int, Float, Bool, String, Char, a sized integer, or a list/optional of those), or write a plain `#Test "name" { … }` block and construct the value yourself
